class.name: SmokeSource
class.brief_description: What one particle emitter is made of.
class.description: How many particles an emitter gives a second, in what cone and how fast they leave, how big, how opaque and of what colour they are born, and how they grow and fade. A particle lives until it has faded out. [SmokeServer] builds an emitter of it ([method SmokeServer.smoke_set_source]).

method.name: get_mean_size
method.description: The mean size a particle is born with.

method.name: get_particle_amount
method.description: How many particles the emitter holds at once: what it gives over [param lifetime] at [param density] times its rate, at most [param max_particles].

method.name: get_particle_lifetime
method.description: How long a particle lives [lb]s[rb]: until the most opaque one has faded out; 0 for a source whose particles never fade.

method.name: get_terminal_size
method.description: The size a particle has grown to after [param lifetime].

members.member: The colour a particle is born with.
How far off the emitter's up axis a particle may leave [lb]deg[rb].
The opacity a particle is born with, picked between [member opacity_min] and this.
How much opacity a particle loses a second (below 0), within [member opacity_limit_min] and [member opacity_limit_max].
The size a particle is born with over the sprite's own, picked between [member size_min] and this.
How much a particle grows a second, within [member size_limit_min] and [member size_limit_max].
The speed a particle leaves at [lb]m/s[rb], picked between [member velocity_min] and this.
